title: Multi-search MVP: research.multi mode (plan, fan out, merge, synthesise) and research-multi CLI
description:
Phase 3 MVP of epic PPY-af6525 (Ryan, 2026-11-01: "a multi search would be a special thing that you would reserve for certain things and not something you would do all the time. I think we will rely on Google as our normal search.").

research.multi is an opt-in assignment type an editor picks per assignment, beside research.tavily-deep; never the default, never automatic. `papyrus assignments research-multi <assignment> [--dry-run]`: one model call plans queries from the brief; every query runs on every configured provider of web_search.py in a thread pool; sources are merged by canonical URL with per-source providers, queries, best rank and snippets; one model call synthesises claims (cited by index), disagreements and open questions; the packet is written through apply_research_packet and intake_research_packet_proposals with per-provider contribution (queries run, hits, unique sources, failures, elapsed ms). A provider failing is recorded and never fatal while another answers; if none answers the assignment records an error and no packet. No page fetching.

Also in this PR: the default web-search chain becomes gemini,openai (was tavily).

Specs: features_backend/assignment-multi-search.feature; procedures/newsroom/tests/test_multi_search_research.py. Docs: docs/automated-publication-research-workflow.md, docs/sources-and-monitoring.md.
